description: How much grass seed to buy for a new lawn: university seeding rates per 1,000 sq ft for each grass type or mix, adjusted for the purity and germination printed on the seed tag. Formula: Pure live seed (PLS) = purity × germination. Seed (lb) = rate (lb PLS per 1,000 sq ft) × area ÷ 1,000 ÷ PLS. Bags = high-rate pounds ÷ bag size, rounded up.
name: calc_grass_seed
title: Grass Seed Calculator (Pounds of Seed for a New Lawn)
